FY27 capex is expected to be around ₹100 crore, focusing on flexible packaging expansion.
Margin performance was impacted by elevated raw material costs and timing lags in passing on price hikes.

timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹453.83 Cr (+7.4% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹21.72 Cr (-42.9% YoY).
TCPL Packaging reported Q4 FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹453.83 Cr and recommended a dividend of ₹25 per share.
TCPL Packaging Limited shared the audio recording of its June 3, 2026, Investors & Analysts Conference Call at **tcpl.in/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/TCPL-Packaging-Q4-FY26-Earnings-Call-Audio.mp3**.
TCPL Packaging reported Q4 FY26 total income of ₹465 Cr and full-year revenue of ₹1,836 Cr, with a guided FY27 capex of ~₹100 Cr.
TCPL Packaging announces entry into lithium-ion battery separator films with ₹125 Cr investment over 18 months, targeting commercial production by Q4FY28
